ns2:section.sectionText: This section is online, asynchronous, and has four individual (1:1) 60-minute meetings. Cripping Art & Design critically and creatively engages the applied research strategies, creative methodologies, and disciplinary conventions of Art and Design fields via the Crip* principles of interdependence, open access, generative difference, radical alterity, networks of support and collaboration, Crip temporalities, and access ecology. This course will serve to discover and design new crip-centric approaches and strategies specific to Art and Design disciplines. Students will schedule four, 60-minute 1:1 synchronous meetings, when available, with at least one course instructor throughout the semester.
